1.title: Prepare and profile the 5G-NIDD dataset and build baseline detectors, reporting both overall accuracy and the detection rate of the rare attack classes to expose the minority-class gap.

2.title: Develop a glass-box detector (EBM) in stages - binary attack detection first, then the harder multiclass case with its severe imbalance - and measure its accuracy against black-box baselines.

3.title: Compare the EBM's intrinsic explanations with post-hoc SHAP explanations of an XGBoost model on identical splits, in terms of clarity, stability and faithfulness.

4.title: Evaluate how imbalance-handling techniques affect minority-class recall, and run a generalisation probe on AWID3, examining whether the kinds of features the model relies on remain informative.

5.title: Produce a simple, analyst-readable explanation output suitable for a non-expert decision-maker.
